subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Should the native popup ship a sanitized Session row only, or also expose richer channel, account, target, and thread identity?
rationale: Session parity uses data already present in the native request, while richer requester context expands the on-screen disclosure of potentially sensitive routing identifiers.

options.title: Session row first
options.body: Add the sanitized non-empty Session row now and handle richer requester identity through a separately reviewed display contract.

options.title: Typed requester identity
options.body: Design and implement a dedicated redacted display model for channel, requester, account, and thread context in the same effort.

recommendation.title: Session row first
recommendation.body: Add the sanitized non-empty Session row now and handle richer requester identity through a separately reviewed display contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the native approval security and presentation path and has already reviewed this issue's product boundary.
